data.name: Panache
data.description: A kata master gains the swashbuckler's panache class ability. At the start of each day, a kata master gains %1 panache points. Her panache goes up or down throughout the day, but usually cannot go higher than %1. A kata master gains the swashbuckler's derring-do and dodging panache deeds. A kata master can use an unarmed strike or monk special weapon in place of a light or one-handed piercing melee weapon for granted swashbuckler class features and deeds.|max(1,CHA)
